{{Quote|He further suggests that Master Luke and Captain Solo might find something to interest them in the Tower's upper chambers. Apparently, there are relics there dating from the middle era of the Old Republic.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />}}
The '''middle era of the Old Republic''' was a [[Time/Legends|time]] period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] considered "ancient" by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> In approximately the middle era of the Republic, a [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Jedi temple]] was constructed on [[Arkinnea]].<ref name="Dark Times 5">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 5|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 5]]</ref> In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], tapestries from this era were on display in the [[Tower of Law]] on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />
